title.zh: 卷八十二 志第三十二: 選舉二
title.raw: 卷八十二 志第三十二: 選舉二 Volume 82 Treatises 35: Selection of Officials 2

sentences.zh: 選舉二 ○銓法上

translations.literal: Selection of Officials 2 ○ Appointment Regulations, Part One
translations.idiomatic: Selection of Officials 2 — Appointment Regulations, Upper Section

sentences.zh: 凡怯薛出身：元初用左右宿衛為心膂爪牙，故四怯薛子孫世為宿衛之長，使得自舉其屬。

translations.literal: As for those who rise from the keshig: at the beginning of the Yuan, the left and right palace guards were used as the heart, sinew, claws, and teeth [of the throne], so the descendants of the four keshig served generation after generation as heads of the palace guard and were permitted to recommend their own subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: On appointments from the keshig ranks: in the early Yuan the left and right palace guards served as the dynasty’s innermost bulwark, so descendants of the four keshig corps held the headship of the guard in hereditary succession and were allowed to nominate their own followers.

sentences.zh: 諸怯薛歲久被遇，常加顯擢，惟長官薦用，則有定制。

translations.literal: The various keshig, having long enjoyed imperial favor, were often conspicuously promoted; only when recommended by their chief officer was there a fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Keshig who had long served at court were frequently advanced to prominent posts; fixed rules applied only when a chief officer recommended someone for appointment.

sentences.zh: 至元二十年議：「久侍禁闥、門地崇高者，初受朝命散官，減職事一等，否則量減二等。」

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Zhiyuan it was deliberated: "Those who have long attended the inner gates and whose family standing is lofty, when first receiving court appointment to nominal rank, shall have their substantive office reduced by one grade; otherwise, their substantive office shall be reduced by two grades as appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of Zhiyuan it was deliberated: "Those who have long attended the inner gates and whose family standing is lofty, when first receiving court appointment to nominal rank, shall have their substantive office reduced by one grade; otherwise, their substantive office shall be reduced by two grades as appropriate."

sentences.zh: 至大四年，詔蒙古人降一等，色目人降二等，漢人降三等。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhida, an edict ordered that Mongols be reduced one grade, Semu persons two grades, and Han persons three grades.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhida 4 an edict stipulated that Mongols would be reduced one grade, Semu two grades, and Han three grades.

sentences.zh: 凡臺憲選用：大德元年，省議：「臺官舊無選法，俱於民職選取，後互相保選，省、臺各為一選。

translations.literal: As for selection and use of censorate and surveillance officials: in the first year of Dade, the Secretariat deliberated: "Censorate offices formerly had no selection method; all were chosen from civilian posts. Later they mutually guaranteed selection, and the Secretariat and Censorate each formed a separate selection.
translations.idiomatic: As for selection and use of censorate and surveillance officials: in the first year of Dade, the Secretariat deliberated: "Censorate offices formerly had no selection method; all were chosen from civilian posts. Later they mutually guaranteed selection, and the Secretariat and Censorate each formed a separate selection.

sentences.zh: 宜令臺官，幕官聽自選擇，惟廉訪司官，則省、臺共選。

translations.literal: It is fitting to let censorate officials and secretariat staff choose for themselves; only surveillance commissioners shall be jointly selected by the Secretariat and Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials and their staff should be free to choose their own appointees; only regional surveillance commissioners would be selected jointly by the Secretariat and Censorate.

sentences.zh: 若臺官於省部選人，則與省官共議之；

translations.literal: If censorate officials select persons from the Secretariat and ministries, they shall deliberate together with Secretariat officials;
translations.idiomatic: When censorate officials chose candidates from the Secretariat or ministries, they would deliberate jointly with Secretariat officials;

sentences.zh: 省官於臺憲選人，亦與臺官共議之。」

translations.literal: when Secretariat officials select persons from the censorate and surveillance service, they likewise shall deliberate together with censorate officials."
translations.idiomatic: when Secretariat officials select persons from the censorate and surveillance service, they likewise shall deliberate together with censorate officials."

sentences.zh: 至元八年，定監察御史任滿，在職無異政，元系七品以下者例加一等，六品以上者升擢。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhiyuan it was fixed that when investigating censors completed their term, if in office they had no exceptional achievements, those originally of seventh rank or below would by rule receive one grade higher, and those of sixth rank or above would be promoted.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 8 it was stipulated that when investigating censors finished a term without notable achievements in office, those who had originally held seventh rank or below would routinely advance one grade, while those of sixth rank or above would receive promotion.

sentences.zh: 其有不顧權勢，彈劾非違，及利國便民者，別議升除。

translations.literal: Those who disregarded powerful interests, impeached unlawful conduct, or benefited the state and the people would have promotion or demotion separately deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: Those who defied powerful interests, impeached wrongdoing, or advanced the public good would have their advancement considered separately.

sentences.zh: 或有不稱者，斟酌銓註。

translations.literal: If any were unfit, appointment would be weighed and registered with discretion.
translations.idiomatic: If any proved unfit, their appointments would be adjusted at discretion.

sentences.zh: 凡選舉守令：至元八年，詔以戶口增、田野辟、詞訟簡、盜賊息、賦役均五事備者，為上選。

translations.literal: As for selecting prefects and magistrates: in the eighth year of Zhiyuan, an edict took as top selection those in whom the five matters were complete—household registers increased, fields opened, lawsuits simplified, banditry stilled, and tax levies and corvée even.
translations.idiomatic: On the selection of prefects and magistrates: in Zhiyuan 8 an edict designated as top candidates officials who had achieved all five standards—growth in registered households, reclamation of farmland, reduction of litigation, suppression of banditry, and equitable taxes and corvée.

sentences.zh: 九年，以五事備者為上選，升一等。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, those with all five matters complete were top selection and advanced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, officials who fulfilled all five criteria were ranked as top selections and advanced one grade.

sentences.zh: 四事備者，減一資。

translations.literal: Those with four matters complete had one qualification reduced [for promotion purposes].
translations.idiomatic: Those who fulfilled four criteria had one qualification period waived toward promotion.

sentences.zh: 三事有成者為中選，依常例遷轉。

translations.literal: Those with achievement in three matters were middle selection and transferred according to the usual rule.
translations.idiomatic: Those who achieved three criteria were middle selections and transferred under the usual regulations.

sentences.zh: 四事不備者，添一資。

translations.literal: Those lacking four matters had one qualification added.
translations.idiomatic: Those who fell short on four criteria had one qualification period added before promotion.

sentences.zh: 五事俱不舉者，黜降一等。

translations.literal: Those who failed in all five matters were demoted one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Those who failed on all five counts were demoted one grade.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，詔：「勸課農桑，克勤奉職者，以次升獎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, an edict stated: "Those who urge agricultural instruction and sericulture and who diligently fulfill their duties shall be promoted and rewarded in order.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, an edict stated: "Those who urge agricultural instruction and sericulture and who diligently fulfill their duties shall be promoted and rewarded in order.

sentences.zh: 其怠於事者，笞罷之。」

translations.literal: Those negligent in their duties were flogged and dismissed."
translations.idiomatic: Those negligent in their duties were flogged and dismissed."

sentences.zh: 二十八年，詔：「路府州縣，除達魯花赤外，長官並宜選用漢人素有聲望，及勛臣故家，並儒吏出身，資品相應者，佐貳官遴選色目、漢人參用，庶期於政平訟理，民安盜息，而五事備矣。」

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, an edict stated: "At circuit, prefecture, subprefecture, and county levels, apart from the darughachi, chief officials should all be selected from Han persons of long-standing reputation, from families of meritorious ministers, and from those of Confucian-clerk background whose qualifications and rank correspond; deputy officials should be chosen with mixed use of Semu and Han, so that government may be level, lawsuits settled, the people secure, banditry stilled, and the five matters complete."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, an edict stated: "At circuit, prefecture, subprefecture, and county levels, apart from the darughachi, chief officials should all be selected from Han persons of long-standing reputation, from families of meritorious ministers, and from those of Confucian-clerk background whose qualifications and rank correspond; deputy officials should be chosen with mixed use of Semu and Han, so that government may be level, lawsuits settled, the people secure, banditry stilled, and the five matters complete."

sentences.zh: 凡進用武官：至元十五年，詔：「軍官有功而升職者，舊以其子弟襲職，陣亡者許令承襲，若罷去者，以有功者代之。」

translations.literal: As for advancing military officers: in the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan, an edict stated: "Military officers who had merit and were promoted—formerly their sons and younger brothers inherited the post; those killed in battle were permitted hereditary succession; if removed from office, a meritorious person was to replace them."
translations.idiomatic: As for advancing military officers: in the fifteenth year of Zhiyuan, an edict stated: "Military officers who had merit and were promoted—formerly their sons and younger brothers inherited the post; those killed in battle were permitted hereditary succession; if removed from office, a meritorious person was to replace them."

sentences.zh: 十七年，詔：「渡江總把、百戶有功升遷者，總把依千戶降等承襲，百戶無遞降職名，則從其本等。」

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, an edict stated: "For zongguan and baihu of the Cross-River [campaign] who were promoted for merit, the zongguan inherited by descending one grade from qianhu; for the baihu, if there was no successive lower title, they kept their original grade."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, an edict stated: "For zongguan and baihu of the Cross-River [campaign] who were promoted for merit, the zongguan inherited by descending one grade from qianhu; for the baihu, if there was no successive lower title, they kept their original grade."

sentences.zh: 十九年，奏擬：「萬戶、千戶、百戶物故，視其子孫堪承襲者，依例承襲外，都元帥、招討使、總管、總把，視其子孫堪承襲者，止令管其元軍。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, a memorial was drafted: "When wanhu, qianhu, and baihu die, if their descendants are fit to inherit, they inherit according to regulation; as for grand marshals, pacification commissioners, zongguan, and zongba, if their descendants are fit to inherit, they are only to be put in charge of their original troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, a memorial was drafted: "When wanhu, qianhu, and baihu die, if their descendants are fit to inherit, they inherit according to regulation; as for grand marshals, pacification commissioners, zongguan, and zongba, if their descendants are fit to inherit, they are only to be put in charge of their original troops.

sentences.zh: 元帥、招討子孫為萬戶，總管子孫為千戶，總把子孫為百戶，給元佩金銀符。

translations.literal: Descendants of marshals and pacification commissioners became wanhu; descendants of zongguan became qianhu; descendants of zongguan became baihu; they were given the original gold and silver tallies.
translations.idiomatic: A marshal’s or pacification commissioner’s descendant would become a wanhu; a zongguan’s descendant a qianhu; a zongguan’s descendant a baihu—and would receive the original gold or silver tally of office.

sentences.zh: 病故者降等，惟陣亡者本等承襲。」

translations.literal: Those who died of illness had their grade reduced; only those killed in battle inherited at the original grade."
translations.idiomatic: Those who died of illness had their grade reduced; only those killed in battle inherited at the original grade."

sentences.zh: 二十一年，詔：「萬戶、千戶、百戶分上中下三等，定立絳格，通行遷轉。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, an edict stated: "Wanhu, qianhu, and baihu were divided into upper, middle, and lower thirds; red registers were established and transfers applied throughout.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, an edict stated: "Wanhu, qianhu, and baihu were divided into upper, middle, and lower thirds; red registers were established and transfers applied throughout.

sentences.zh: 以三年為滿，理算資考，升加品級。

translations.literal: A three-year term was full; qualifications were calculated and ranks raised.
translations.idiomatic: A three-year term would complete service; qualifications would be reckoned and ranks advanced.

sentences.zh: 若年老病故者，令其子弟依例蔭敘。」

translations.literal: If old or dead from illness, their sons and younger brothers were to receive hereditary privilege according to regulation."
translations.idiomatic: If old or dead from illness, their sons and younger brothers were to receive hereditary privilege according to regulation."

sentences.zh: 是年，以舊制父子相繼，管領元軍，不設蒙古軍官，故定立資考，三年為滿，通行遷轉。

translations.literal: That year, because under the old system father and son succeeded one another in command of the original troops and no separate Mongol military officers were appointed, qualifications were therefore established, a three-year term was full, and transfers applied throughout.
translations.idiomatic: That same year, because the old system had fathers and sons succeed one another in command of original troops without separate Mongol military officers, qualification terms were fixed at three years with transfers applied throughout.

sentences.zh: 後各翼大小軍官俱設蒙古軍官，又兼調遣征進，俱已離翼，難與民官一體遷轉蔭敘，合將萬戶、千戶、鎮撫自奏準日為始，以三年為滿，通行遷轉。

translations.literal: Later, large and small military officers of each wing all had Mongol military officers appointed; they were also assigned to campaigns and advances, all having left their wings, making it difficult to transfer and grant hereditary privilege together with civilian officials. It was fitting that for wanhu, qianhu, and zhenfu, counting from the day of memorial approval, a three-year term be full and transfers apply throughout.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Mongol officers were appointed at every level in each wing and officers were also dispatched on campaigns away from their units, they could no longer be transferred or granted hereditary privilege like civilian officials. Wanhu, qianhu, and zhenfu would therefore count three-year terms from the date of approved memorial and transfer under the general rule.

sentences.zh: 百戶以下，不拘此例。

translations.literal: Baihu and below were not bound by this rule.
translations.idiomatic: Centurion-commanders and lower ranks were not subject to this rule.

sentences.zh: 凡軍官征戰有功過者，驗實跡升降。

translations.literal: All military officers with merit or fault in campaign were promoted or demoted upon verification of actual deeds.
translations.idiomatic: Military officers were promoted or demoted according to verified achievements or failures in the field.

sentences.zh: 又定蒙古奧魯官，大翼萬戶下設奧魯總管府，從四品。

translations.literal: Mongol ordo officials were also fixed: under large-wing wanhu an ordo chief steward’s office was established, rank 4b.
translations.idiomatic: Mongol ordo officials were also regulated: under large-wing wanhu an ordo chief steward’s office of rank 4b was established.

sentences.zh: 小翼萬戶下設奧魯官，從五品。

translations.literal: Under small-wing wanhu an ordo official was established, rank 5b.
translations.idiomatic: Under small-wing wanhu an ordo official of rank 5b was established.

sentences.zh: 各千戶奧魯，亦設奧魯官，受院劄。

translations.literal: For each qianhu ordo as well, an ordo official was established, receiving a commission from the Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Each qianhu ordo likewise had an ordo official appointed by commission from the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 各千戶奧魯，不及一千戶者，或二百戶、三百戶，以遠就近，以小就大，合並為千戶翼奧魯官，受院劄。

translations.literal: For qianhu ordos of less than one thousand households, whether two hundred or three hundred households, drawing from far to near and from small to large, they were merged into qianhu-wing ordo officials receiving Bureau commission.
translations.idiomatic: Qianhu ordos numbering fewer than one thousand households—whether two or three hundred—would be consolidated from nearby and smaller units into qianhu-wing ordo officials commissioned by the Bureau.

sentences.zh: 若干礙投下，難以合並，宜再議之。

translations.literal: Where several impeded appanage holdings made merger difficult, further deliberation was appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Where appanage holdings obstructed consolidation, the matter should be reconsidered.

sentences.zh: 又定首領官受敕牒，元帥、招討司經歷、知事，就充萬戶府經歷、知事，換降敕牒，如元翼該革，別與遷除。

translations.literal: It was also fixed that leading officers received edict patents; marshals’ and pacification commissioners’ bureau managers and clerks served directly as wanhu-office managers and clerks, exchanging for lowered edict patents; if the original wing should be abolished, separate transfer and appointment was given.
translations.idiomatic: Leading officers were also required to hold edict patents: bureau managers and clerks of marshal and pacification offices would serve as wanhu-office managers and clerks upon exchange of patents; if the original wing was abolished, they would be reassigned elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 若王令旨、並行省劄付、樞密院劄付經歷，充中、下萬戶府知事。

translations.literal: Managers with princely orders, provincial commissions, or Bureau of Military Affairs commissions served as clerks of middle and lower wanhu offices.
translations.idiomatic: Managers holding princely orders, provincial commissions, or Bureau commissions would serve as clerks in middle- and lower-grade wanhu offices.

sentences.zh: 行省諸司劄付，充提領案牘，並各翼萬戶自設經歷、知事，一例俱作提控案牘，受院劄。

translations.literal: Provincial and various office commissions served as document controllers; and each wing’s wanhu-appointed managers and clerks were uniformly made document controllers receiving Bureau commission.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial and departmental commissions would fill document-controller posts; managers and clerics appointed by each wing’s wanhu would uniformly serve as document controllers under Bureau commission.

sentences.zh: 又議：「隨朝各衛千戶鎮撫所提控案牘，已擬受院劄，外任千戶鎮撫所提控案牘，合從行省許準，受萬戶府付身。」

translations.literal: It was further deliberated: "Document controllers of qianhu zhenfu at court guards were already drafted to receive Bureau commission; document controllers of qianhu zhenfu on external assignment should receive provincial approval and a warrant from the wanhu office."
translations.idiomatic: It was further deliberated: "Document controllers of qianhu zhenfu at court guards were already drafted to receive Bureau commission; document controllers of qianhu zhenfu on external assignment should receive provincial approval and a warrant from the wanhu office."

sentences.zh: 二十四年，詔：「諸求襲其父兄之職者，宜察其人而用之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, an edict stated: "All who seek to inherit their father’s or elder brother’s office should have the person examined and then employed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, an edict stated: "All who seek to inherit their father’s or elder brother’s office should have the person examined and then employed.

sentences.zh: 凡舊臣勛閥及有戰功者，其子弟當先任以小職，若果有能，則大用之。」

translations.literal: All sons and younger brothers of old ministers of meritorious houses and those with battle achievements should first be given small posts; if truly capable, they were then greatly employed."
translations.idiomatic: All sons and younger brothers of old ministers of meritorious houses and those with battle achievements should first be given small posts; if truly capable, they were then greatly employed."

sentences.zh: 二十五年，軍官陣亡者，本等承襲，病故者，降二等。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, military officers killed in battle inherited at the original grade; those who died of illness had their grade reduced two levels.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, officers killed in battle could inherit at the original grade; those who died of illness would have succession reduced by two grades.

sentences.zh: 雖陣亡，其子弟無能，勿用。

translations.literal: Even if killed in battle, if their sons and younger brothers were incapable, they were not employed.
translations.idiomatic: Even when an officer died in battle, unfit sons would not be appointed.

sentences.zh: 雖病故，其子弟果能，不必降等，於本等用之。

translations.literal: Even if dead from illness, if their sons and younger brothers were truly capable, reduction of grade was unnecessary; they were employed at the original grade.
translations.idiomatic: Even when an officer died of illness, capable sons need not suffer grade reduction and could be appointed at the original rank.

sentences.zh: 大德四年，以上都虎賁司並武衛內萬戶、千戶、百戶達魯花赤亡歿，而無奏準承襲定例，似為偏負。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Dade, because darughachi of wanhu, qianhu, and baihu in the Shangdu Tiger Guard Bureau and Martial Guard had died without a fixed regulation for memorial-approved inheritance, it seemed a partial injustice.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 4, because darughachi of wanhu, qianhu, and baihu posts in the Shangdu Tiger Guard and Martial Guard had died without approved rules for hereditary succession, the practice seemed unfairly inconsistent.

sentences.zh: 今後各翼達魯花赤亡歿，宜察其子弟有能者用之，無能則止。

translations.literal: Henceforth when darughachi of each wing died, their capable sons and younger brothers should be examined and employed; if incapable, appointment ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, when a wing’s darughachi died, capable sons would be examined and appointed; incapable heirs would not succeed.

sentences.zh: 五年，詔：「軍官有不赴任者，有患病因事不行者，有已赴任、被差委而出、公事已辦為私事稱故不回者，今後宜限以六月。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an edict stated: "Military officers who did not take up their posts, who were ill or detained by affairs, or who having taken up post were dispatched out, finished public business, then claimed illness for private affairs and did not return—hereafter a limit of six months should apply.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, an edict stated: "Military officers who did not take up their posts, who were ill or detained by affairs, or who having taken up post were dispatched out, finished public business, then claimed illness for private affairs and did not return—hereafter a limit of six months should apply.

sentences.zh: 越限者以他人代之，期年後以他職授之。」

translations.literal: Those exceeding the limit were replaced by others; after a year they were given another office."
translations.idiomatic: Those exceeding the limit were replaced by others; after a year they were given another office."

sentences.zh: 十一年，詔：「色目鎮撫已歿，其子有能，依例用之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, an edict stated: "When a Semu zhenfu had died, if his son was capable, he was employed according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, an edict stated: "When a Semu zhenfu had died, if his son was capable, he was employed according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 子幼，則取其兄弟之子有能者用之，俟其子長，即以其職還之。」

translations.literal: If the son was young, a capable son of his brother was taken and employed; when his son grew up, the office was returned to him."
translations.idiomatic: If the son was young, a capable son of his brother was taken and employed; when his son grew up, the office was returned to him."

sentences.zh: 至大二年，議：「各衛翼首領官，至經歷以上，不得升除，似與官軍一體，其子孫乃不得承襲。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhida, it was deliberated: "Leading officers of each guard wing, from manager upward, could not be promoted or demoted, seeming to be the same as regular troops, so their descendants could not inherit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhida, it was deliberated: "Leading officers of each guard wing, from manager upward, could not be promoted or demoted, seeming to be the same as regular troops, so their descendants could not inherit.

sentences.zh: 今後年逾七十，而散官至正從四品者，宜正從五品軍官內任用。」

translations.literal: Henceforth those over seventy whose nominal rank reached regular and subordinate fourth rank should be employed within regular and subordinate fifth-rank military officers."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth those over seventy whose nominal rank reached regular and subordinate fourth rank should be employed within regular and subordinate fifth-rank military officers."

sentences.zh: 四年，詔：「軍官有故，令其嫡長子，亡歿，令嫡長孫為之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict stated: "When a military officer had cause [to leave office], his eldest legitimate son [succeeded]; if dead, the eldest legitimate grandson did so.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, an edict stated: "When a military officer had cause [to leave office], his eldest legitimate son [succeeded]; if dead, the eldest legitimate grandson did so.

sentences.zh: 嫡長孫亡歿，則令嫡長孫之嫡長子為之。

translations.literal: If the eldest legitimate grandson was dead, the eldest legitimate son of the eldest legitimate grandson did so.
translations.idiomatic: If the eldest legitimate grandson had died, the eldest legitimate son of that grandson would succeed.

sentences.zh: 若嫡長俱無，則以其兄弟之子相應者為之。」

translations.literal: If there were no legitimate eldest heirs, then a suitable son of his brother did so."
translations.idiomatic: If no legitimate eldest heirs remained, a suitable nephew would succeed."

sentences.zh: 太禧院。

translations.literal: The Grand Prosperity Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Prosperity Bureau.

sentences.zh: 天歷元年，罷會福、殊祥二院而立之，秩正二品。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianli, the Bureau of Assembled Blessings and Bureau of Special Auspice were abolished and it was established, rank 2a.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianli 1 the Bureau of Assembled Blessings and Bureau of Special Auspice were abolished and this bureau was established at rank 2a.

sentences.zh: 其所轄諸司，則從其擢用。

translations.literal: For the various offices under its jurisdiction, it followed its own selections for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate offices under its jurisdiction were staffed at its own discretion.

sentences.zh: 宣徽院。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Palace Insignia.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau of Palace Insignia.

sentences.zh: 皇慶二年，省臣奏：「其所轄倉庫、屯田官員，半由都省，半由本院用之。」

translations.literal: In the second year of Huangqing, Secretariat ministers memorialized: "Warehouse and garrison-farm officials under its jurisdiction—half were employed by the Metropolitan Secretariat, half by this Bureau."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Huangqing, Secretariat ministers memorialized: "Warehouse and garrison-farm officials under its jurisdiction—half were employed by the Metropolitan Secretariat, half by this Bureau."

sentences.zh: 奉旨，宜俱從省臣用之。

translations.literal: By imperial order, all should follow Secretariat ministers in employment.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial order, all such appointments were to be made by Secretariat ministers.

sentences.zh: 中政院。

translations.literal: The Central Governance Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Governance Bureau.

sentences.zh: 至大四年言：「諸司錢糧選法，悉令中書省掌之，可更選人任用，移文中書，給降宣敕。」

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhida it was stated: "Selection methods for fiscal offices of various bureaus are all to be managed by the Secretariat; persons may be reselected and employed, documents sent to the Secretariat, and edict commissions issued."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhida it was stated: "Selection methods for fiscal offices of various bureaus are all to be managed by the Secretariat; persons may be reselected and employed, documents sent to the Secretariat, and edict commissions issued."

sentences.zh: 延祐七年，院臣啟：「皇后位下中政院用人，奉懿旨，依樞密院、御史臺等例行之。」

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yanyou, bureau ministers reported: "For appointments by the Central Governance Bureau under the empress, by imperial rescript, follow the precedent of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Censorate, and the like."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yanyou, bureau ministers reported: "For appointments by the Central Governance Bureau under the empress, by imperial rescript, follow the precedent of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Censorate, and the like."

sentences.zh: 直省舍人，內則侍相臣之興居，外則傳省闥之命令，選宿衛及勛臣子弟為之。

translations.literal: Direct secretariat attendants: within they attended the chief minister’s daily life; without they transmitted the Secretariat’s commands; palace guards and sons of meritorious ministers were selected for this.
translations.idiomatic: Direct secretariat attendants attended the chief minister within the palace and transmitted Secretariat orders without; they were chosen from palace guards and sons of meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 又擇其高等二人，專掌奏事。

translations.literal: Two of the highest grade were further chosen to manage memorials exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: Two senior attendants were further selected to handle memorials exclusively.

sentences.zh: 至元二十五年，省臣奏：「其充是職者，俾受宣命。」

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Zhiyuan, Secretariat ministers memorialized: "Those who fill this office should be made to receive formal appointment."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year of Zhiyuan, Secretariat ministers memorialized: "Those who fill this office should be made to receive formal appointment."

sentences.zh: 大德八年，擬歷六十月者，始令從政。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Dade, it was drafted that after sixty months of service they might begin participating in government.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 8 it was stipulated that after sixty months of service they could enter regular government posts.

sentences.zh: 凡禮儀諸職：有太常寺檢討，至元十三年，擬歷一百月，除從八品。

translations.literal: As for various ritual offices: there was the Court of Imperial Sacrifices collator; in the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan, after one hundred months of service, appointment to rank 8b was drafted.
translations.idiomatic: On ritual offices: the Court of Imperial Sacrifices collator, in Zhiyuan 13, would be appointed to rank 8b after one hundred months of service.

sentences.zh: 有御史臺殿中司知班，十五年，擬歷九十月，除正八品。

translations.literal: There was the Censorate Hall Duty shift manager; in the fifteenth year, after ninety months, appointment to rank 8a was drafted.
translations.idiomatic: There was the Censorate Hall Duty shift manager; in the fifteenth year, appointment to rank 8a after ninety months was proposed.

sentences.zh: 有通事舍人，二十年，議：「從本司選已入流品職官為之，考滿驗應得資品，升一等遷用。

translations.literal: There were communication attendants; in the twentieth year it was deliberated: "Select from this bureau officials already in the regular ranks; when the term is full verify the qualification and rank due, and promote one grade for transfer.
translations.idiomatic: There were communication attendants; in the twentieth year it was deliberated: "Select from this bureau officials already in the regular ranks; when the term is full verify the qualification and rank due, and promote one grade for transfer.

sentences.zh: 未入流官人員，擬充侍儀舍人，受中書省劄，一考除從九品。」

translations.literal: Persons not yet in the regular ranks were drafted to fill ceremonial attendants, received Secretariat commission, and after one term were appointed to rank 9b."
translations.idiomatic: Persons not yet in the regular ranks were drafted to fill ceremonial attendants, received Secretariat commission, and after one term were appointed to rank 9b."

sentences.zh: 三十年，議：「於二品、三品官子內選用，不限蔭敘，兩考從七品遷敘。」

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year it was deliberated: "Select from among sons of second- and third-rank officials, without limit of hereditary privilege; after two terms transfer at rank 7b."
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year it was deliberated: "Select from among sons of second- and third-rank officials, without limit of hereditary privilege; after two terms transfer at rank 7b."

sentences.zh: 有侍儀舍人，三十年，議：「於四品、五品官子內選用，不限蔭敘，一考從九品。」

translations.literal: There were ceremonial attendants; in the thirtieth year it was deliberated: "Select from among sons of fourth- and fifth-rank officials, without limit of hereditary privilege; after one term, rank 9b."
translations.idiomatic: There were ceremonial attendants; in the thirtieth year it was deliberated: "Select from among sons of fourth- and fifth-rank officials, without limit of hereditary privilege; after one term, rank 9b."

sentences.zh: 大德三年，議：「有闕，宜令侍儀司於到部正從九品流官內選用，仍受省劄，三十月為滿，依朝官內升轉，如不敷，於應得府州儒學教授內選用，歷一考，正九品敘。」

translations.literal: In the third year of Dade it was deliberated: "When there is a vacancy, the Ceremonial Bureau should select from regular-rank officials of ranks 9a and 9b who have reported to the ministry; they still receive provincial commission; thirty months is full; promotion follows court officials within; if insufficient, select from qualified prefectural and subprefectural Confucian-school instructors; after one term, rank 9a appointment."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Dade it was deliberated: "When there is a vacancy, the Ceremonial Bureau should select from regular-rank officials of ranks 9a and 9b who have reported to the ministry; they still receive provincial commission; thirty months is full; promotion follows court officials within; if insufficient, select from qualified prefectural and subprefectural Confucian-school instructors; after one term, rank 9a appointment."

sentences.zh: 有禮直管勾，大德三年，省選合用到部人員，俱從太常寺舉保，非常選除充者，任回止於本衙門敘用。

translations.literal: There was the ritual duty controller; in the third year of Dade, provincially selected qualified personnel reporting to the ministry were all recommended by the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; those not appointed through regular selection, upon term completion, were ranked only within their original office.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual duty controller: in Dade 3 qualified personnel selected by the province would be recommended by the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; those not appointed through regular selection would be ranked only within their original bureau after completing a term.

sentences.zh: 有郊壇庫藏都監二人，至大三年，議：「受省劄者歷一考之上，受部劄者歷兩考之上，再歷本院屬官一任，擬於從九品內敘。」

translations.literal: There were two directors of suburban altar treasury stores; in the third year of Zhida it was deliberated: "Those with provincial commission must have served more than one term; those with ministry commission more than two terms; then serve one term as subordinate of this bureau; appointment within rank 9b is drafted."
translations.idiomatic: There were two directors of suburban altar treasury stores; in the third year of Zhida it was deliberated: "Those with provincial commission must have served more than one term; those with ministry commission more than two terms; then serve one term as subordinate of this bureau; appointment within rank 9b is drafted."

sentences.zh: 天歷二年，擬在朝文翰衙門，於國子生員內舉充。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianli, it was drafted that at court literary offices, candidates would be nominated from National University students.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianli 2 court literary offices would nominate National University students for these posts.

sentences.zh: 至元九年，部議：「巡檢流外職任，擬三十月為一考，任回於從九品遷敘。」

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhiyuan, the ministry deliberated: "Patrol inspectors are extra-regular posts; thirty months are drafted as one term; upon return from term, transfer at rank 9b."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Zhiyuan, the ministry deliberated: "Patrol inspectors are extra-regular posts; thirty months are drafted as one term; upon return from term, transfer at rank 9b."

sentences.zh: 二十年，議：「巡檢六十月，升從九品。」

translations.literal: In the twentieth year it was deliberated: "After sixty months as patrol inspector, promotion to rank 9b."
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year it was deliberated: "After sixty months as patrol inspector, promotion to rank 9b."

sentences.zh: 大德七年，議：「各處所委巡檢，自立格月日為始，已歷兩考之上者，循舊例九十月出職；

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Dade it was deliberated: "Patrol inspectors commissioned in various places, counting from the date of their own register, those who have served more than two terms follow the old rule of ninety months before leaving post;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Dade it was deliberated: "Patrol inspectors commissioned in various places, counting from the date of their own register, those who have served more than two terms follow the old rule of ninety months before leaving post;

sentences.zh: 不及兩考者，須歷一百二十月，方許出職遷轉。」

translations.literal: those with less than two terms must serve one hundred twenty months before being permitted to leave post and transfer."
translations.idiomatic: those with less than two terms must serve one hundred twenty months before being permitted to leave post and transfer."

sentences.zh: 十年，省奏：「奉旨腹裏巡檢，任回及考者，止於巡檢內註授。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Secretariat memorialized: "By imperial order, metropolitan patrol inspectors who completed a term and passed review were appointed only within patrol inspector posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Secretariat memorialized: "By imperial order, metropolitan patrol inspectors who completed a term and passed review were appointed only within patrol inspector posts.

sentences.zh: 所歷未及者，於錢谷官內定奪，通理巡檢月日。

translations.literal: Those whose service time fell short were decided among fiscal officers, with patrol inspector months reckoned together.
translations.idiomatic: Those with insufficient service would be placed among fiscal officers, with patrol inspector months counted toward qualification.

sentences.zh: 各處行省所設巡檢，考滿者，咨省定奪；

translations.literal: Patrol inspectors established by provincial administrations in various places, when review was complete, were decided by consultation with the province;
translations.idiomatic: Provincial patrol inspectors who completed review would be decided by the province;

sentences.zh: 未及考滿者，行省於錢谷官等職內委用，通理月日，依舊升轉；

translations.literal: those not yet completing review were commissioned by the province among fiscal officers and the like, months reckoned together, promoted according to the old rule;
translations.idiomatic: those not yet completing review would be assigned to fiscal posts with months counted toward promotion under the old rules;

sentences.zh: 不及一考，如系告蔭並提控案牘例應轉充者，於雜職內委用，考滿各理本等月日，依例升轉。」

translations.literal: those with less than one term, if entitled by hereditary privilege or document-controller precedent to transfer, were commissioned among miscellaneous offices; when review was complete each reckoned months at original grade and was promoted according to regulation."
translations.idiomatic: those with less than one term who qualified by hereditary privilege or document-controller precedent would be assigned to miscellaneous offices and, upon review, have months counted at their original grade for promotion."

sentences.zh: 腹裏諸路行用鈔庫，至元十九年，部擬：「州縣民官內選充，系八品、九品人員，三十月為滿，任回驗元資品，減一資歷，通理遷敘。

translations.literal: Paper-note treasuries in use on metropolitan circuits: in the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan, the ministry drafted: "Select from prefectural and county civilian officials; persons of ranks 8 and 9; thirty months is full; upon return verify original qualification and rank, reduce one qualification period, reckon together for transfer.
translations.idiomatic: Paper-note treasuries in use on metropolitan circuits: in the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan, the ministry drafted: "Select from prefectural and county civilian officials; persons of ranks 8 and 9; thirty months is full; upon return verify original qualification and rank, reduce one qualification period, reckon together for transfer.

sentences.zh: 庫使，受都省劄付，任滿從優遷敘。

translations.literal: Treasury managers received Metropolitan Secretariat commission; upon term completion they were transferred preferentially.
translations.idiomatic: Treasury managers, commissioned by the Metropolitan Secretariat, would receive preferential promotion upon completing a term.

sentences.zh: 庫副，受本路劄付，二十月為滿，於本處上戶內公選交替。

translations.literal: Deputy treasurers received circuit commission; twenty months was full; they were publicly selected in rotation from leading households of the locality.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy treasurers, commissioned by the circuit, would serve twenty-month terms and rotate by public selection from leading local households.

sentences.zh: 陜西、四川、西夏中興等路提舉司鈔庫，俱系行省管領，合就令依上選擬庫官，移文都省，給降敕牒劄付。」

translations.literal: Paper-note treasuries of the supervisory offices of Shaanxi, Sichuan, Xixia Zhongxing, and other circuits were all under provincial administration; it was fitting to have treasury officers selected according to the above, send documents to the Metropolitan Secretariat, and issue edict patents and commissions."
translations.idiomatic: Paper-note treasuries of the supervisory offices of Shaanxi, Sichuan, Xixia Zhongxing, and other circuits were all under provincial administration; it was fitting to have treasury officers selected according to the above, send documents to the Metropolitan Secretariat, and issue edict patents and commissions."

sentences.zh: 省議：「除鈔庫使副咨各省選擬外，提領省部選註。」

translations.literal: The Secretariat deliberated: "Apart from treasury managers and deputies consulted and selected by each province, supervisors were selected and registered by the provincial ministry."
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat deliberated: "Apart from treasury managers and deputies consulted and selected by each province, supervisors were selected and registered by the provincial ministry."

sentences.zh: 腹裏官員，二十六年，定選充倉庫等官，擬於應得資品上升一等，通理月日升轉。

translations.literal: Metropolitan officials: in the twenty-sixth year, selection to fill warehouse and other offices was fixed; promotion one grade above the qualification due was drafted, with months reckoned together for advancement.
translations.idiomatic: For metropolitan officials, in the twenty-sixth year appointment to warehouse and similar posts would advance one grade above due qualification, with service months counted toward promotion.

sentences.zh: 江南官員，若曾腹裏歷仕，前資相應依例升轉。

translations.literal: Jiangnan officials, if they had formerly served in the metropolitan interior, with corresponding prior qualifications were promoted according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan officials who had previously served in the metropolitan interior would be promoted according to regulation if prior qualifications matched.

sentences.zh: 遷去江淮歷仕人員，所歷月日一考之上者，除一考準為根腳，余有月日，後任通理；

translations.literal: Personnel who had served in Jianghuai and moved away: if months served exceeded one term, one term was deducted as foundation, and remaining months were reckoned together in later posts;
translations.idiomatic: Officials who had served in the Jianghuai region and moved elsewhere: if service exceeded one term, one term would count as foundation and remaining months would apply to later posts;

sentences.zh: 不及考者，添一資。

translations.literal: those falling short of a term had one qualification added.
translations.idiomatic: those with less than one term would have one qualification period added.

sentences.zh: 若選充倉庫等官，擬於應得資品上，例升一等，任回依上於腹裏升轉。

translations.literal: If selected to fill warehouse and other offices, promotion one grade above the qualification due was drafted; upon return, promotion in the metropolitan interior followed the above.
translations.idiomatic: If appointed to warehouse and similar posts, they would advance one grade above due qualification and, upon return, be promoted in the metropolitan interior under the rules above.

sentences.zh: 接連官員選充倉庫等官，應本地面從七品者，準算腹裏從七資品。

translations.literal: For officials successively selected to fill warehouse and other offices, those who in their home region should be rank 7b: count as metropolitan-interior rank-7b qualification and rank.
translations.idiomatic: Officials appointed in succession to warehouse and related posts who would be rank 7b in their home region were credited with metropolitan-interior rank-7b qualifications.

sentences.zh: 歷過一考者，為始理算月日，後任通理；

translations.literal: Those who had completed one term: from that point reckon months and days; in later posts reckon together.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had served one full term would begin counting months and days from that point, with remaining time carried over to later appointments.

sentences.zh: 一考之上，余有月日，後任通理；

translations.literal: Beyond one term, if remaining months and days exist, reckon together in later posts.
translations.idiomatic: Any months beyond one term would also carry forward to later posts.

sentences.zh: 不及考者，添一資升轉。

translations.literal: Those falling short of a term: add one qualification period for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Those with less than one term would add one qualification period before promotion.

sentences.zh: 福建、兩廣官員選充倉庫等官，應得本地面從七品者，準算江南從七資品。

translations.literal: Officials of Fujian and the Two Guang selected to fill warehouse and other offices, who in their home region should be rank 7b: count as Jiangnan rank-7b qualification and rank.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian and Two Guang officials appointed to warehouse posts who would be rank 7b locally were credited with Jiangnan rank-7b qualifications.

sentences.zh: 歷過一考者，為始理算月日；

translations.literal: Those who had completed one term: from that point reckon months and days;
translations.idiomatic: Those who had completed one term would begin counting months and days from that point;

sentences.zh: 一考之上，余有月日，後任通理；

translations.literal: Beyond one term, if remaining months and days exist, reckon together in later posts.
translations.idiomatic: Any months beyond one term would carry forward to later posts.

sentences.zh: 不及考者，添一資升轉。

translations.literal: Those falling short of a term: add one qualification period for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Those with less than one term would add one qualification period before promotion.

sentences.zh: 元系流官，任回，止於流官內任用；

translations.literal: Those originally regular officials, upon return, were only appointed within regular officials;
translations.idiomatic: Regular officials, upon completing a special appointment, could only be reassigned within the regular bureaucracy;

sentences.zh: 雜職者，雜職內遷敘。

translations.literal: miscellaneous officers were promoted and transferred within miscellaneous offices.
translations.idiomatic: miscellaneous officers would be promoted only within miscellaneous posts.

sentences.zh: 萬億庫、寶鈔總庫、八作司，以一年滿代，錢物甚多，未易交割，宜以二年為滿，少者以一年為滿。

translations.literal: Trillion Treasury, Paper-Note General Treasury, and Eight Crafts Directorate had one-year terms, but funds and goods were so numerous that handover was difficult; two years should be the term, with lesser ones at one year.
translations.idiomatic: The Trillion Treasury, Paper-Note General Treasury, and Eight Crafts Directorate had originally one-year terms, but their vast holdings made handover difficult, so two-year terms were set, with smaller offices at one year.

sentences.zh: 上都稅務官，止依上例遷轉。

translations.literal: Shangdu tax officers were only to be promoted according to the above precedents.
translations.idiomatic: Shangdu tax officers would follow the same promotion rules above.

sentences.zh: 都省所轄去處，二周歲為滿者：各處都轉運使司官、司屬官、首領官，各處都漕運使司官、首領官，諸路寶鈔都提舉司官，腹裏、江南隨路平準行用庫官，印造寶鈔庫官，鐵冶提舉司官、首領官，采金提舉司官、首領官，銀場提舉司官、首領官，新舊運糧提舉司官、首領官，都提舉萬億庫、八作司、寶鈔總庫首領官。

translations.literal: Places under the Metropolitan Secretariat with two-year terms: commissioners of every Regional Transport Commission and their subordinate and leading officers; commissioners of every Grand Canal Transport Commission and their leading officers; supervisors-general of paper-note offices on every circuit; circulation treasuries on metropolitan-interior and Jiangnan circuits; paper-note printing treasuries; iron-smelting supervisory offices and their leading officers; gold-mining supervisory offices and their leading officers; silver-field supervisory offices and their leading officers; new and old grain-transport supervisory offices and their leading officers; leading officers of the supervising offices for the Trillion Treasury, Eight Crafts Directorate, and Paper-Note General Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Metropolitan Secretariat, two-year terms applied to: all Regional Transport commissioners, subordinates, and section heads; Grand Canal Transport commissioners and section heads; circuit-wide paper-note supervisors; circulation treasuries in the metropolitan interior and Jiangnan; paper-note printing treasuries; iron, gold, and silver supervisory offices and their section heads; grain-transport supervisory offices (new and old) and section heads; and section heads of the Trillion Treasury, Eight Crafts Directorate, and Paper-Note General Treasury.

sentences.zh: 一周歲為滿者：泉府司所轄富藏庫官，廩給司、四賓庫、薄斂庫官，大都稅課提舉司官、首領官，酒課提舉司官、首領官，提舉太倉官、首領官，提舉醴源倉官、首領官，大都省倉官，河倉官，通州等處倉官、應受省部劄付管錢谷院務雜職等官，大都平準行用庫官，燒鈔四庫官，抄紙坊官，弊源庫官。

translations.literal: One-year terms: treasury officers of the Rich Storehouse under the Commissariat; officers of the Grain-Ration Directorate, Four-Guest Treasury, and Light-Levy Treasury; officers and leading officers of the Dadu Tax-Revenue Supervisory Office, Liquor-Revenue Supervisory Office, Grand Granary Supervisory Office, and Brewery-Source Granary Supervisory Office; Dadu provincial granary officers; river granary officers; granary officers at Tongzhou and elsewhere; miscellaneous fiscal officers of revenue yards receiving provincial-ministry commissions; Dadu circulation treasury officers; the four note-burning treasuries; paper-milling workshop officers; and worn-note source treasury officers.
translations.idiomatic: One-year terms covered: Rich Storehouse officers under the Commissariat; Grain-Ration, Four-Guest, and Light-Levy treasuries; Dadu tax, liquor, grand granary, and brewery-source supervisory offices and their section heads; provincial and river granaries; Tongzhou granaries; miscellaneous fiscal yard officers under ministry commission; the Dadu circulation treasury; note-burning treasuries; paper mills; and worn-note treasuries.

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the province drafted: "Zhongzheng Commission dispatch envoys select from record clerks with three terms or more in this office and from rank-9a and 9b officials, with Semu and Han mutually participating; those pursued on their own initiative demote one grade."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, the province drafted: "Zhongzheng Commission dispatch envoys select from record clerks with three terms or more in this office and from rank-9a and 9b officials, with Semu and Han mutually participating; those pursued on their own initiative demote one grade."

sentences.zh: 十一年，省擬：「燕南廉訪司奏差，州吏內選補，考滿於都目內遷用。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, the province drafted: "Yannan Surveillance Commission presentation memorial envoys—select and fill from prefectural clerks; when review is complete, transfer among chief clerk registrars."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, the province drafted: "Yannan Surveillance Commission presentation memorial envoys—select and fill from prefectural clerks; when review is complete, transfer among chief clerk registrars."

sentences.zh: 延祐三年，省議：「各衙門典吏，須歷九十月，方許轉補奏差。」

translations.literal: In the third year of Yanyou, the province deliberated: "Record clerks of each office must serve ninety months before permitted to transfer to presentation memorial envoy."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yanyou, the province deliberated: "Record clerks of each office must serve ninety months before permitted to transfer to presentation memorial envoy."

sentences.zh: 凡匠官：至元九年，工部驗各管戶數，二千戶之上至一百戶之上，隨路管匠官品級。

translations.literal: On craftsman officials: in the ninth year of Zhiyuan, the Works Ministry verified household counts under each jurisdiction—from two thousand households and above down to one hundred households and above—setting rank grades of route craftsman officials accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Craftsman officials: in Zhiyuan 9 the Works Ministry set route craftsman ranks by verified household counts from two thousand down to one hundred.

sentences.zh: 省議：「除在都總提舉司去處，依準所擬。

translations.literal: The province deliberated: "Except where under the metropolitan Directorate-General, follow the draft.
translations.idiomatic: The province deliberated: "Except where under the metropolitan Directorate-General, follow the draft.

sentences.zh: 東平雜造提舉司並隨路織染提舉司，二千戶之上，提舉正五品，同提舉從六品，副提舉從七品。

translations.literal: Dongping Miscellaneous Manufacture Directorate and route Dyeing Directorates, two thousand households and above: intendant rank 5a, associate intendant rank 6b, deputy intendant rank 7b.
translations.idiomatic: For Dongping Miscellaneous Manufacture and route Dyeing Directorates with two thousand or more households, the intendant would be rank 5a, associate 6b, and deputy 7b.

sentences.zh: 一千戶之上，提舉從五品，同提舉正七品，副提舉正八品。

translations.literal: One thousand households and above: intendant rank 5b, associate intendant rank 7a, deputy intendant rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: At one thousand or more households, ranks would be intendant 5b, associate 7a, and deputy 8a.

sentences.zh: 五百戶之上至一千戶之下，提舉正六品，同提舉從七品，副提舉從八品。

translations.literal: Five hundred households and above to one thousand households and below: intendant rank 6a, associate intendant rank 7b, deputy intendant rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: From five hundred to one thousand households, ranks would be intendant 6a, associate 7b, and deputy 8b.

sentences.zh: 三百戶之上，大使正七品，副使正八品。

translations.literal: Three hundred households and above: director rank 7a, deputy rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: At three hundred or more households, the director would be rank 7a and the deputy 8a.

sentences.zh: 一百戶之上，大使從七品，副使從八品。

translations.literal: One hundred households and above: director rank 7b, deputy rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: At one hundred or more households, the director would be rank 7b and the deputy 8b.

sentences.zh: 一百戶之下，院長一員，同院務，例不入流品，量給食錢。

translations.literal: Below one hundred households: one institute director, same as institute affairs, by convention outside the flowing ranks, with food allowance as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Below one hundred households there would be one institute director, like institute affairs staff outside the regular bureaucracy, receiving a modest food allowance.

sentences.zh: 凡一百戶之下管匠官資品，受上司劄付者，依已擬充院長。

translations.literal: For craftsman officials below one hundred households—those receiving a superior's writ: follow the draft to fill institute director.
translations.idiomatic: Craftsman officials under one hundred households who held a superior's writ would serve as institute directors under the draft.

sentences.zh: 已受宣牌充局使者，比附一百戶之上局使資品遞降，量作正九資品。」

translations.literal: Those already receiving an edict plaque as bureau envoys: compare downward from bureau-director qualifications for households of one hundred and above, set as rank 9a qualification."
translations.idiomatic: Those already receiving an edict plaque as bureau envoys: compare downward from bureau-director qualifications for households of one hundred and above, set as rank 9a qualification."

sentences.zh: 二十二年，凡選取升轉匠官資格，元定品給員數，提舉司二千戶之上者，無之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, on selecting and promoting craftsman-official qualifications—the originally fixed ranks and quota numbers: for directorates of two thousand households and above, none."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year promotion rules for craftsman officials left no fixed ranks for directorates of two thousand or more households.

sentences.zh: 一千戶之上，提舉從五品，同提舉正七品，副提舉正八品。

translations.literal: One thousand households and above: intendant rank 5b, associate intendant rank 7a, deputy intendant rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: At one thousand or more households, ranks would be intendant 5b, associate 7a, and deputy 8a.

sentences.zh: 五百戶之上、一千戶之下，提舉正六品，同提舉從七品，副提舉從八品。

translations.literal: Five hundred households and above, one thousand households and below: intendant rank 6a, associate intendant rank 7b, deputy intendant rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: From five hundred to under one thousand households, ranks would be intendant 6a, associate 7b, and deputy 8b.

sentences.zh: 使副，三百戶之上，局使正七品，副使正八品。

translations.literal: Director and deputy—for three hundred households and above: bureau director rank 7a, deputy rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: For three hundred or more households, the bureau director would be rank 7a and the deputy 8a.

sentences.zh: 一百戶之上，局使從七品，副使從八品。

translations.literal: One hundred households and above: bureau director rank 7b, deputy rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: At one hundred or more households, the bureau director would be rank 7b and the deputy 8b.

sentences.zh: 一百戶之下，院長一員，比同務院，例不入流品。

translations.literal: Below one hundred households: one institute director, compared with affairs institute, by convention outside the flowing ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Below one hundred households there would be one institute director, like an affairs institute, outside the regular bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 工部議：「三百戶之上局副從八，一百戶之上局副正九，遇有闕，於一百戶之下院長內選充。

translations.literal: The Works Ministry deliberated: "Deputy bureau directors rank 8b for three hundred households and above, rank 9a for one hundred households and above; when vacancies occur, select from institute directors below one hundred households to fill.
translations.idiomatic: The Works Ministry deliberated: "Deputy bureau directors rank 8b for three hundred households and above, rank 9a for one hundred households and above; when vacancies occur, select from institute directors below one hundred households to fill.

sentences.zh: 院長一百二十月升正九，正九兩考升從八，從八三考、正八兩考，俱升從七。

translations.literal: Institute director: one hundred twenty months to rank 9a; rank 9a two terms to rank 8b; rank 8b three terms and rank 8a two terms, both to rank 7b.
translations.idiomatic: Institute directors would advance after 120 months to rank 9a, then through stated terms to ranks 8b and 7b.

sentences.zh: 如正八有闕，別無資品相應人員，於已授從八匠官內選註，通歷九十月，升從七；

translations.literal: If rank 8a has a vacancy and no personnel of corresponding qualification, select and register from appointed rank-8b craftsman officials; total ninety months' service, promote to rank 7b;
translations.idiomatic: Vacant rank-8a posts without qualified candidates would be filled from rank-8b craftsman officials with ninety months' total service before promotion to 7b;

sentences.zh: 從七三考升正七，正七兩考升從六；

translations.literal: rank 7b three terms to rank 7a, rank 7a two terms to rank 6b;
translations.idiomatic: rank 7b required three terms for 7a, and rank 7a two terms for 6b;

sentences.zh: 從六三考、正六兩考，俱升從五。

translations.literal: rank 6b three terms and rank 6a two terms, both to rank 5b.
translations.idiomatic: rank 6b required three terms and rank 6a two terms for promotion to 5b.

sentences.zh: 如所轄司屬無從六，名闕，如已歷正七兩考，擬升加從六散官，止於正七匠官內遷轉，九十月升從五。

translations.literal: If subordinate offices lack rank 6b and the name is vacant, if already served rank 7a two terms, draft promotion adding rank 6b honorary rank, only transfer among rank-7a craftsman officials; ninety months to rank 5b.
translations.idiomatic: Without subordinate rank-6b posts, a craftsman official with two terms at 7a could receive honorary 6b and remain among 7a craftsman officials until ninety months brought promotion to 5b.

sentences.zh: 如正六匠官有闕，於已授從六散官人員內選註，通歷九十月升從五。

translations.literal: If rank-6a craftsman officials have vacancies, select and register from appointed rank-6b honorary personnel; total ninety months' service promotes to rank 5b.
translations.idiomatic: Vacant rank-6a craftsman posts would be filled from honorary rank-6b holders with ninety months' service for promotion to 5b.

sentences.zh: 從五三考擬升正五，別無正五匠官，名闕，升加正五散官，止於從五匠官內遷轉。

translations.literal: Rank 5b three terms drafts promotion to rank 5a; if no rank-5a craftsman official and the name is vacant, promote adding rank 5a honorary rank, only transfer among rank-5b craftsman officials.
translations.idiomatic: After three terms at 5b, promotion to 5a was proposed; without rank-5a craftsman posts, honorary 5a would be added while officials remained among rank-5b craftsman officers.

sentences.zh: 如歷仕年深，至日斟酌定奪。

translations.literal: If years in office are long, deliberate and decide on the day.
translations.idiomatic: Long-serving officials would receive case-by-case decisions.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年以前受宣敕省劄人員，依管民官例，擬準已受資品。

translations.literal: Personnel receiving edicts and provincial writs before the twelfth year of Zhiyuan: follow civilian-official precedent, grant the qualification already received.
translations.idiomatic: Those commissioned before Zhiyuan 12 would keep their received qualifications under civilian-official precedent.

sentences.zh: 十三年以後受宣敕省劄人員，若有超升越等者，驗實歷俸月定擬，合得資品上例存一等遷用。

translations.literal: After the thirteenth year, personnel receiving edicts and provincial writs—if promoted beyond proper grade, verify actual salary months and draft; use one grade lower than the due qualification for transfer.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhiyuan 13, over-promoted appointees would have salaries verified and transfer capped one grade below due qualification.

sentences.zh: 管匠官遇有闕員去處，如無資品相應之人，擬於雜職資品相應到選人內銓用。

translations.literal: When craftsman-official posts are vacant and no persons of corresponding qualification, draft selection and use from miscellaneous-service candidates of corresponding qualification among those arriving for selection.
translations.idiomatic: Vacant craftsman posts without qualified candidates would be filled from miscellaneous-service appointees of matching qualification.

sentences.zh: 凡中原、江淮匠官，正從五品子從九品匠官內蔭敘，六品、七品子於院長內敘用。

translations.literal: Central Plains and Jiang-Huai craftsman officials: sons of rank-5a and 5b officials enter rank-9a and 9b craftsman ranks by inheritance; sons of rank-6a and 7a officials are used among institute directors.
translations.idiomatic: In the Central Plains and Jiang-Huai, sons of rank-5 officials would inherit rank-9 craftsman posts, and sons of rank-6 and 7 officials would serve as institute directors.

sentences.zh: 以匠官無從九，名闕，擬正從五品子應蔭者，於正九匠官內銓註，任回，理算從九月日。」

translations.literal: Because craftsman officials have no rank 9b and the name is vacant, draft that sons of rank-5a and 5b officials entitled to inheritance register among rank-9a craftsman officials; upon return, reckon from-nine-month date."
translations.idiomatic: Because craftsman officials have no rank 9b and the name is vacant, draft that sons of rank-5a and 5b officials entitled to inheritance register among rank-9a craftsman officials; upon return, reckon from-nine-month date."

sentences.zh: 二十三年，詔：「管匠官，其造作有好惡虧少，勿令遷轉。」

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, an edict stated: "Craftsman officials—if manufacture is good or bad with shortfall, do not permit transfer."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, an edict stated: "Craftsman officials—if manufacture is good or bad with shortfall, do not permit transfer."

sentences.zh: 二十四年，部言：「管匠衙門首領官，宜於本衙門內選委知會造作相應人員區用，勿令遷轉，合依舊例，從本部於常選內選差相應人員掌管案牘，任滿交代遷敘。」

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, the ministry stated: "Leading officials of craftsman offices should be selected and commissioned from suitable personnel within the office who understand manufacture, and should not be transferred. Following the old rule, this ministry should select suitable personnel from the regular selection pool to manage documents; when their term is complete, they hand over and transfer by the promotion sequence."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, the ministry stated: "Leading officials of craftsman offices should be selected and commissioned from suitable personnel within the office who understand manufacture, and should not be transferred. Following the old rule, this ministry should select suitable personnel from the regular selection pool to manage documents; when their term is complete, they hand over and transfer by the promotion sequence."

sentences.zh: 元貞元年，準湖廣行省所擬：「三千戶之上提舉司從五品，提舉從五品，同提舉正七品，副提舉正八品。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanzhen, the Huguang Branch Secretariat draft was approved: "For directorates of three thousand households and above, rank 5b; intendant rank 5b, associate intendant rank 7a, deputy intendant rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanzhen, the Huguang Branch Secretariat draft was approved: "For directorates of three thousand households and above, rank 5b; intendant rank 5b, associate intendant rank 7a, deputy intendant rank 8a.

sentences.zh: 二千戶之上提舉司正六品，提舉正六品，同提舉從七品，副提舉從八品。

translations.literal: For directorates of two thousand households and above, rank 6a; intendant rank 6a, associate intendant rank 7b, deputy intendant rank 8b.
translations.idiomatic: Two-thousand-household directorates would be rank 6a, with intendant 6a, associate 7b, and deputy 8b.

sentences.zh: 一千戶之上局，局使正七品，副使正八品。

translations.literal: For bureaus of one thousand households and above: bureau director rank 7a, deputy rank 8a.
translations.idiomatic: Thousand-household bureaus would have a rank-7a director and rank-8a deputy.

sentences.zh: 五百戶之上局，局使從七品，副使正九品。

translations.literal: For bureaus of five hundred households and above: bureau director rank 7b, deputy rank 9a.
translations.idiomatic: Five-hundred-household bureaus would have a rank-7b director and rank-9a deputy.

sentences.zh: 五百戶之下，院長一員。」

translations.literal: Below five hundred households: one institute director."
translations.idiomatic: Below five hundred households: one institute director."

sentences.zh: 凡諸王分地與所受湯沐邑，得自舉其人，以名聞朝廷，而後授其職。

translations.literal: For all princely appanage lands and received ceremonial fiefs, they may recommend their own people, report the names to the court, and only then receive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Princes holding appanage lands or ceremonial fiefs could nominate their own men, report names to court, and receive appointment thereafter.

sentences.zh: 至元二年，詔以各投下總管府長官不遷外，其所屬州縣長官，於本投下分到城邑內遷轉。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhiyuan, an edict stated that chief officials of each appanage surveillance commission would not be transferred outside, while prefectural and county chiefs under them would rotate within cities assigned to that appanage."
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 2 appanage surveillance chiefs would not leave their jurisdictions, but subordinate prefectural and county officials would rotate within the appanage's assigned cities.

sentences.zh: 四年，省劄：「應給印官員，若受宣命及諸王令旨、或投下官員批劄、省府樞密院制府左右部劄付者，驗戶給印。」

translations.literal: In the fourth year, a provincial writ stated: "Officials due to receive seals—if they hold imperial appointment, princely orders, appanage officers' endorsements, or writs from the Secretariat, provincial offices, Privy Council, or Offices of the Left and Right—verify households and grant the seal."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, a provincial writ stated: "Officials due to receive seals—if they hold imperial appointment, princely orders, appanage officers' endorsements, or writs from the Secretariat, provincial offices, Privy Council, or Offices of the Left and Right—verify households and grant the seal."

sentences.zh: 五年，詔：「凡投下官，必須有蒙古人員。」

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an edict stated: "All appanage officials must include Mongol personnel."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, an edict stated: "All appanage officials must include Mongol personnel."

sentences.zh: 六年，以隨路見任並各投下創差達魯花赤內，多女直、契丹、漢人，除回回、畏吾兒、乃蠻、唐兀同蒙古例許敘用，其餘擬合革罷，曾歷仕者，於管民官內敘用。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, because among route incumbents and appanage-appointed darughachi there were many Jurchen, Khitan, and Han—except Hui, Uighur, Naiman, and Tangut, who follow the Mongol precedent and may be employed, the rest were drafted for abolition; those who had served would be appointed among civilian officials."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year most non-Mongol darughachi among Jurchen, Khitan, and Han appointees were to be removed, except Hui, Uighur, Naiman, and Tangut treated like Mongols, with former incumbents reassigned as civilian officials.

sentences.zh: 十九年，詔：「各投下長官，宜依例三年一次遷轉。」

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, an edict stated: "Each appanage chief should rotate every three years according to regulation."
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, an edict stated: "Each appanage chief should rotate every three years according to regulation."

sentences.zh: 省臣奏：「江南諸王分地長官，已令如例遷轉，其間若有兼管軍鎮守為達魯花赤者，一體代之，似為不宜。

translations.literal: Provincial ministers memorialized: "Jiangnan princely appanage chiefs have already been ordered to rotate according to regulation; among them, if some also command troops and garrison as darughachi, replacing them as one body seems unsuitable.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial ministers memorialized: "Jiangnan princely appanage chiefs have already been ordered to rotate according to regulation; among them, if some also command troops and garrison as darughachi, replacing them as one body seems unsuitable.

sentences.zh: 合令於投下長官之上署字，一同蒞事。」

translations.literal: They should countersign above the appanage chief and jointly preside over affairs."
translations.idiomatic: They should countersign above the appanage chief and jointly preside over affairs."

sentences.zh: 二十年，議：「諸王各投下千戶，於江南分地已於長官內委用，其州縣長官，亦令如之，似為相宜。」

translations.literal: In the twentieth year it was deliberated: "Each prince's appanage qianhu in Jiangnan fiefs have already been commissioned among chiefs; prefectural and county chiefs should likewise be ordered—this seems suitable."
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year it was deliberated: "Each prince's appanage qianhu in Jiangnan fiefs have already been commissioned among chiefs; prefectural and county chiefs should likewise be ordered—this seems suitable."

sentences.zh: 二十三年，諸王、駙馬並百官保送人員，若曾仕者，驗資歷於州縣內相間用，如無歷仕，從本投下自用。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, princes, imperial sons-in-law, and all officials' recommended personnel—if they had formerly served, verify qualifications and use alternately in prefectures and counties; if they had no service history, use them within the original appanage."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year recommended personnel with prior service would be placed in prefectures and counties by verified qualification; those without service history would remain within their appanage.

sentences.zh: 三十年，各投下州縣長官，三年一次給由互相遷轉，如無可遷轉，依例給由申呈省部，仍牒廉訪司體訪。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, each appanage prefectural and county chief would every three years receive credentials for mutual rotation; if none could be rotated, issue credentials and report to the Secretariat and ministries according to regulation, and still dispatch the Surveillance Commission for inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: By the thirtieth year appanage prefectural and county chiefs would rotate every three years on issued credentials, or report to central authorities and the Surveillance Commission when no rotation was possible.

sentences.zh: 大德元年，諸投下達魯花赤從七以下者，依例類選。

translations.literal: In the first year of Dade, appanage darughachi of rank 7b and below would be selected by category according to regulation."
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 1 appanage darughachi of rank 7b and below would follow categorical selection rules.

sentences.zh: 十年，議：「各投下官員，非奉省部明文，毋得擅自離職。」

translations.literal: In the tenth year it was deliberated: "Appanage officials may not leave their posts on their own initiative without a document from the Secretariat or ministries."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year it was deliberated: "Appanage officials may not leave their posts on their own initiative without a document from the Secretariat or ministries."

sentences.zh: 皇慶二年，詔：「各投下分地城邑長官，其常選所用者，居眾人之上，投下所委者為添設，其常選內路府州及各縣內減一員。」

translations.literal: In the second year of Huangqing, an edict stated: "For chiefs of appanage fief cities, those used by the regular selection stand above the multitude; those commissioned by the appanage are supplementary; reduce one regular post within each interior circuit prefecture and each county."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Huangqing, an edict stated: "For chiefs of appanage fief cities, those used by the regular selection stand above the multitude; those commissioned by the appanage are supplementary; reduce one regular post within each interior circuit prefecture and each county."

sentences.zh: 三年，以中下縣主簿、錄事司錄判掌錢糧捕盜等事，不宜減去，並增置副達魯花赤一員。

translations.literal: In the third year, because lower and middle county registrars and Record Affairs Office recorders handling grain, funds, and bandit suppression should not be reduced, they would also add one deputy darughachi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year lower and middle county registrars and Record Affairs recorders handling revenue and policing would not be cut, and a deputy darughachi would be added.

sentences.zh: 四年，凡投下郡邑，令自置達魯花赤，其為副者罷之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, for all appanage prefectures and districts, let them appoint their own darughachi; deputy posts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year appanage prefectures could appoint their own darughachi and deputy posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 各投下有闕用人，自於其投下內選用，不許冒用常選內人。

translations.literal: When appanages had vacancies, they would select from within that appanage; they might not improperly use personnel from the regular selection.
